runsheet.short_description: Optional: Study the 10 papers; Network with presenters.
Join Slack channels corresponding to your session: #oral-session-? and #poster-session-?, and most importantly, #oral-session-?-presenters.
Tell presenters their session slot and presentation position. Remind each presenter to keep their mode of attendance up to date via Google Form.
runsheet.more_info: If the paper is listed as 'Px-y Title...' on Miniconf and Slack, then it is presented as the y-th paper in Oral Session x.

runsheet.short_description: Use your own laptop to test open all slide submissions. Your laptop will not be used during the Oral Session, but is a good sanity check.
Review name pronunciations. In #oral-session-?-presenters, re-send the presentation order, and remind presenters to sit in the front row.

Go to the stage laptop. Download slides / video from [Sheet for Session Chair](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JPkY1TY8BfC07ZicIe6FDiZt94PALu3r6AFXhavpwlY/edit?gid=1217880391#gid=1217880391) and order them in a local folder.
[[Webinar Sentinel]] confirm where [[Zoom Master]] will sit. [[Zoom Master]] says hi to and assist [[On-site Session Chair]] on the stage.

runsheet.more_info: Chat > menu > attendees can chat with: nobody.

runsheet.short_description: Promote [[Webinar Sentinel]], and maybe backstage to cohost in the Zoom webinar.

Sit on-site in the backstage but view only the Zoom Webinar on the provided laptop. Not only listen, but try to understand and enjoy the presentaions --- you catch more issues this way. Keep the on-site screen visible so any mismatch is catched, but pay main attention to the webinar. Use the provided headphones. Upon issues, use judgement: Either unmute to raise the issue, or contact the [[Zoom Master]] immediately by walking to them.
Sit in the corner of the audience to enjoy the presentations.

Introduce your name, institution, your role as the On-site Session Chair, and, if you want, a 1-sentence research topic. Announce that the Oral Session does NOT have time for Q&A, and introduce your gestures/cards for '2 minutes passed' and '3 minutes passed'.
runsheet.more_info: Cards: maybe simply write with pen and paper?

runsheet.short_description: where T<sub>y</sub> is the start of each presentation. Make sure the presenter is ready and by the stage. Open the right slides. Introduce the paper title and the presenter. Be brief, nice, and non-distracting.
runsheet.more_info:
Tip. Extra words easily distract the audience. The presentations are fast. If a person spends 15 seconds thinking about what you just said, they've missed the first slide.
If the presenter is not ready in 30 seconds, fallback to playing the pre-recorded video.

runsheet.short_description: Signal the presenter again. From this point on, use your judgement whether to barge in and stop the presentation. Consider remaining time.
runsheet.more_info: If you have to stop a presentation, you can then warmly welcome the audience to the poster of that paper. Remember to be non-distracting.

runsheet.short_description: Announce the end of the Oral Session, thank the presenters, and direct the audience to the Poster location. Check the schedule: if there is a Majlis at the same time, mention its title.
[[Zoom Master]] reminds [[Venue AV/IT]] to screenshare 'quit this Webinar and go to the Zoom Meeting for Poster Session.'
